name: Kourou ELA-4
best_known_for: Ariane 6's home pad — Europe's geostationary access after Ariane 5
credit: Ariane 6 pad at the Centre Spatial Guyanais, sibling to ELA-3. Construction began 2015; maiden flight of Ariane 6 on July 9, 2024 (VA262). Inherits the 5.2°N equatorial geometry that made Ariane 5 successful; designed for a higher cadence than ELA-3 with a horizontal-integration assembly building and a sliding mobile gantry. Europe's strategic-autonomy launch capability for institutional + commercial GEO payloads. Coordinates from CNES + ESA records.
